long_biography.plain_text:
Working full time through high school and college, George Leon Argyros supported his family and paid his way through Chapman University. After managing a grocery store, he borrowed $1,200 to enter Orange County real estate and eventually founded Arnel & Affiliates. Its apartment and commercial-property portfolio established the fortune that later supported private-equity investments and other business ventures.

Public service followed business success rather than creating it. Argyros served for three years as United States ambassador to Spain and Andorra after earlier corporate and trade-policy roles. He later combined chairmanship of Arnel with partnership at Westar Capital. Alongside his wife, Julia, he has also directed substantial support to education, healthcare and community institutions through family philanthropy.
